meta.name: ux-heuristics
meta.description: Evaluate and improve interface usability using heuristic analysis. Use when the user mentions "usability audit", "users are confused", "form usability", "navigation problems", "Nielsen heuristics", "cognitive walkthrough", or "is this easy to use". Also trigger when reviewing a design for usability issues, improving form-completion rates, or evaluating information architecture and navigation. Covers Krug's laws, Nielsen's 10 heuristics, severity ratings, dark-pattern recognition, and accessibility. For visual design fixes, see refactoring-ui. For conversion-focused audits, see cro-methodology.

copy.tagline: 评估界面可用性并给出改进建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要检查产品界面是否好用并找出问题。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate interface usability and provide improvement suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check if your product interface is easy to use and find issues.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照尼尔森十大可用性原则、克鲁格可用性定律等框架，对界面进行可用性审计，找出问题并给出严重等级评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“可用性审计”、“用户困惑”、“导航问题”、“尼尔森启发式”等关键词，或要求评估界面易用性、改善表单完成率时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个登录页面的可用性，按尼尔森十大原则评分。
say.note: Claude 会逐条检查并给出严重等级和改进建议。

say.text: 这个表单用户总是填错，怎么改进？
say.note: Claude 会分析表单的可用性问题，如标签、错误提示等。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will audit interfaces using Nielsen's 10 heuristics and Krug's laws, identify usability issues, rate severity, and suggest fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "usability audit", "users are confused", "navigation problems", "Nielsen heuristics", or ask to evaluate ease of use or improve form completion.

say_en.text: Audit this login page for usability using Nielsen's heuristics.
say_en.note: Claude will check each heuristic and rate severity.

say_en.text: Users keep making errors on this form. How to improve?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze form usability issues like labels and error messages.
